question: A flagpole has a shadow measuring 10 meters. Given that the height of the flagpole is 10√3 meters, What is the angle at which the sun is elevated?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The tangent of the angle of elevation (θ) is the ratio of the flagpole's height to the shadow's length.

⇒ tan(θ) = 10√3 ÷ 10

⇒ tan(θ) = √3

Since tan(60°) = √3, the angle of elevation of the sun is 60°.

**∴ The correct answer is 60°.**
